known_structural_pressure: minimum item counts can force unnecessary possibilities
minimum item counts can force heavy or irrelevant change conditions
required fields can repeat limitations and disclaimers
fixed three-day structures can fabricate a Day 3 action
minimum closing content can produce a long repetitive ending
current_schema.conclusion: The current Schema remains immutable here. A successor contract is required before final quality implementation.

recommended_message_draft.rule: Exactly one when the decision and selected request require a draft; absent for a send-nothing result.

message_draft_edit_metadata.rule: Present only when a draft exists.

aftercare_plan.rule: Each item must add distinct action value.

change_conditions.rule: Include only material facts that could change the application-owned recommendation.

material_unknowns.rule: Include only unknowns that matter to the decision or safe execution.

model_generated_limitations.rule: Do not repeat the fixed general limitation.

short_letter.topic_dependency: Full depth only when organize_emotions is selected; otherwise minimum useful content.

possible_interpretations.rule: Evidence-bounded readings only; no hidden-mind assertion.

closing_lines.rule: No repeated disclaimer or summary padding.

cross_contract_invariants: One recommended draft is the standard.
Draft voice and report voice remain separate.
Optional generated prose cannot create a mandatory section through renderer fallback.
Selected request fulfillment remains mandatory even when topic-dependent sections may be empty.
Safety, decision, user constraints, and candidate communicative intent remain application-owned or typed boundaries.
No runtime, Prompt, Schema, UI, Policy, provider, or database change is authorized by this proposal.
